slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: ffprobe on both exports: spec resolution, codec, and constant frame rate within 1%.
Flash-and-beep calibration measured with ffmpeg signalstats and silencedetect: offset under 45 ms at start and under 80 ms at 10 minutes.
slides.alt: DejaViewed carousel, slide 6 of 8. Proof. How you know it worked. ffprobe on both exports: spec resolution, codec, and constant frame rate within 1%. Flash-and-beep calibration measured with ffmpeg signalstats and silencedetect: offset under 45 ms at start and under 80 ms at 10 minutes.

slides.heading: Portal captures video but no system audio
paras: ffprobe shows a single mic stream; tone missing on playback.
per-session null sink and record its monitor, or record audio separately and mux with ffmpeg.
slides.alt: DejaViewed carousel, slide 7 of 8. Biggest failure mode. Portal captures video but no system audio. Tell: ffprobe shows a single mic stream; tone missing on playback. Fix: per-session null sink and record its monitor, or record audio separately and mux with ffmpeg.
